title: EDG Community Update: June 27th, 2022
body:
**Highlights**
- The Event Trilogy series comes to an end with the triumphant conclusion of the third and final campaign ‘[Crypto Quiz](https://discord.com/invite/fHyucD4VHx)’.
- [Nova Wallet added support](https://twitter.com/NovaWalletApp/status/1543989670979174404) for the Kabocha parachain.
- All validators are requested to upgrade their nodes to the [release v3.3.3](https://github.com/hicommonwealth/edgeware-node/releases) to proceed further with the ERUP5/Wako upgrade through the on-chain governance. The core community dev Ramsey recently shared [the docker image for v3.3.3 aka ERUP5/Wako upgrade](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1438226365833175048?s=20) to save the compiling hustle for node/validator owners.
- Upcoming Activities: AMA with Placeholder Labs, AMA with Rusty Crewmates, Kabocha’s Technical AMA ft. Ramsey, Kabocha’s Community Mods Onboarding Quiz


**Ecosystem Updates**
- Edgeware ecosystem developers can take advantage of [OnFinality’s newest addition to their workspace suite aka ‘Multi-Apps’](https://twitter.com/OnFinality/status/1542037285100584960?s=20&t=TQwGwziug-5C6tqB2ZlHIg), a container for the set of API keys, dashboards, and analytics all organised in one place.
- Get to know more technical-oriented updates on the ‘[Developer Update aka EDG Dev Digest](https://blog.edgewa.re/edg-developer-update-june-26/)’.
- Looking for the speculative performance of EDG? Check out the [Community-run DAO Financial Bulletins](https://blog.edgewa.re/tag/bi-weekly/).
- EDGizens are welcomed to participate in [the research survey](https://forms.gle/XdjEyBEMY1EtZs3x9) by one of the ecosystem partners.
- Community Treasury-funded Web3 Media platform, [New-Futures opened up pre-registrations](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1469353591433478150?s=20) for their highly anticipated upcoming launch.
- Community members interested in running bridge relayers or Chainlink’s oracle nodes on EdgeEVM, please reach out to ops@edgeware.agency.
- Community mem
